response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer (15+ years) with strong full-stack, TypeScript, distributed-systems and testing/craftsmanship credentials, plus recent exposure to MCP code generators and agentic developer tooling at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years shipping production-grade AI solutions, and his demonstrable GenAI experience is roughly one year of infrastructure/tooling work rather than building AI systems. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability work, no multi-agent frameworks, and only limited cloud experience (AWS CDK at Optilyz) with no cloud AI platform work. Strong engineering baseline and customer-adjacent consulting/mentoring history, but the core GenAI requirements are largely unmet.
strengths: 15+ years senior/staff-level engineering across web, backend, embedded and high-throughput systems
Recent hands-on MCP and agentic developer tooling experience, plus strong TypeScript/Node depth
Proven mentoring, workshops, consulting and open-source leadership (GISCollective, talks, courses)
concerns: No evidence of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions
Missing core stack: Python, vector databases, RAG, multi-agent frameworks, LLM evaluation
Limited cloud platform depth; no AI systems designed on AWS/GCP/Azure

key_factors.factor: Depth of general senior/staff engineering experience
